_about: PehRadar M5 demo scenarios. Each run plays a licensed sample clip (demo_assets/SOURCES.md) on a SIMULATED demo-stream node and runs it through the real fire/smoke detector when trigger_after_seconds pass. A positive result becomes a pending detection for operator review; nothing is ever auto-confirmed. expected_behavior documents the intended outcome; the real model decides the actual one.

scenarios.name: Korangi industrial fire
scenarios.description: Night building fire on the Korangi Industrial Area node. Expected: a pending FIRE detection for operator review.

scenarios.name: Clifton structure smoke
scenarios.description: Heavy structure smoke on the Clifton Boat Basin node. Expected: a pending SMOKE detection for operator review.

scenarios.name: Lyari sunset glare (false-alarm lookalike)
scenarios.description: Orange sunset glare and tail lights on the Lyari node. Expected: the temporal rule does not confirm fire or smoke, so no detection is created.
